[[File:OpticalThermalImagingScope-FF73.png|thumb|right|250px|The power amplifier circuitry module on Zam Wesell's KiSteer 1284 rifle]]
'''Power amplifier circuitry''' was a modification that could increase the firing rate of a [[Slugthrower rifle|projectile]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]. [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle/Legends|KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle]] was equipped with a power amplifier circuitry module, which also necessitated the addition of a [[recoil-damping stock]] to accommodate the additional power.<ref name="FF73">{{FactFile|73|WES 3-4|Zam Wesell's Weapons}}</ref>
